channel.title: HeyNortheast Media Private Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from HeyNortheast Media Private Limited (thenewsmill.com)

item.title: Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu Lead India in 2026 Thomas &amp; Uber Cup
item.description: India announces squads for the 2026 Thomas and Uber Cup Finals in Denmark, featuring Lakshya Sen, PV Sindhu, and a mix of experienced and young players.

item.title: Delhi Budget 2026: Rs 103,700 Crore Focuses on Infrastructure
item.description: The 2026 Delhi budget totals Rs 103,700 crore, emphasizing infrastructure, sustainability, and social welfare initiatives for the city's development.

item.title: BJP MP Sigriwal Criticizes Opposition's Response to Modi's Speech
item.description: BJP MP Janardan Singh Sigriwal urges the opposition to accept PM Modi's positive appeals regarding the West Asia conflict during a Lok Sabha address.

item.title: KK Goswami Visits Ayodhya to Seek Lord Ram's Blessings
item.description: Actor KK Goswami visits Ayodhya for prayers and filming, expressing joy over seeking blessings from Lord Ram ahead of Ram Navami celebrations.

item.title: BEL and RRP Group Sign MoU for Defence Semiconductor Development
item.description: Bharat Electronics Limited and RRP Group signed an MoU to develop semiconductors and drones, enhancing India's defence exports and indigenous capabilities.

item.title: PM Modi extends Good Friday greetings in India
item.description: PM Modi highlights Jesus Christ's teachings on Good Friday, promoting harmony and compassion as devotees across India observe the day with prayers and processions.

item.title: Mohd Amin criticizes Malda hostage crisis in West Bengal
item.description: Mohd Amin condemns the Malda hostage crisis as shameful, criticizing West Bengal's government and emphasizing the need for a purifying voter list process.

item.title: GMC&AH Rajouri enhances healthcare with new 200-bed facility
item.description: GMC&AH in Rajouri, J&K, has upgraded to a 200-bed facility with advanced technology, improving healthcare services for the Pir Panjal region.

item.title: Global crude oil supplies disrupted by West Asia conflict, warns SMC
item.description: Vandana Bharti of SMC Global Securities reports a daily loss of 10 million barrels in crude oil supplies amid ongoing West Asia conflict, with prices surging.

item.title: Punjab Congress leader Khushbaz Singh Jatana killed in accident
item.description: Khushbaz Singh Jatana and his driver were killed in a road accident on the KMP Expressway in Sonipat, Haryana, while changing a flat tyre.

item.title: Good Friday observances across India: prayers and processions
item.description: Devotees in India marked Good Friday with prayers and processions, including the 'Way of the Cross' in Tamil Nadu and services in Kolkata and Delhi.

item.title: DMK's V Sabareesan confident of victory in Tamil Nadu elections
item.description: V Sabareesan, son-in-law of CM MK Stalin, expresses confidence in DMK's win in Tamil Nadu elections, highlighting ongoing welfare schemes and manifesto commitments.

item.title: Chhattisgarh High Court orders Amit Jogi to surrender in 2003 murder case
item.description: The Chhattisgarh High Court has ordered Amit Jogi to surrender within three weeks in a 2003 murder case, overturning his previous acquittal after 23 years.

item.title: Delhi police prevent secret burial in honour killing case
item.description: Delhi police stopped a secret burial linked to an honour killing, confirming the girl's death by smothering. A murder case has been registered.

item.title: North Western Railway adds coaches and special trains for summer
item.description: North Western Railway is operating holiday special trains and adding extra coaches to accommodate increased passenger demand during the summer vacation.
